source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    1. Power on and boot in BIOS.
2. Press load default,save and reboot.
3. Boot in BIOS,compare setting should matches SPEC.
4. Change BIOS all/random setting in this function,to non-default  setting.
5. Save and reboot.
6. Boot in BIOS and check your setting still exist.

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. The default setting should matches SPEC."
2. No error log happen.
3. Normal reboot ,no hang、crash happen.
4. Check your set still exist.

original_test_intent: Verify AMD North Bridge chipset defaults and persistence of approved non-default controls without destabilizing memory training, NUMA/coherency, PCIe/graphics topology, power/thermal behavior, boot or workload placement assumptions.
original_method: Manually load defaults, compare named North Bridge fields with the exact platform SPEC, change only a bounded topology/policy matrix, save and apply the documented reset, verify persistence and correlate memory, NUMA, PCIe, graphics, power and RAS evidence.
manual_activity: An engineer must interpret, operate and visually accept North Bridge BIOS fields. Automated topology and health evidence only corroborates the manual firmware acceptance.
required_inputs: Named fields mapped to memory training/interleave, NUMA/coherency, PCIe/graphics and power dependencies
SPEC defaults and approved non-default values
Expected NUMA nodes, memory capacities, link/device topology and power/thermal limits
Required cold/warm reset, stable power and independent console/OOB recovery
safety_requirements: Never operationalize all/random or change memory/NUMA/coherency or PCIe routing without exact platform approval.
Protect boot storage, management NIC, GPU/display, memory availability and required workload topology.
Use stable power and preserve training/RAS logs; do not hide errors by clearing the only evidence.
Capture persistent device and DIMM/NUMA identities before changes; do not rely on enumeration order.
Stop on training failure, memory loss/remap, NUMA mismatch, device loss, thermal excursion, RAS error, boot or management failure.
Restore the approved final state; no automatic retry.
agent_execution_scope: Collect read-only CPU/DIMM/memory/NUMA, PCIe/graphics topology, persistent IDs, power/thermal/RAS telemetry, boot logs and BMC health.
Compare owner-approved expected topology and health deltas around operator phases without starting stress.
Do not drive BIOS, alter NUMA/device policy, online/offline resources or decide PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve exact fields, topology dependencies, values, reset/training expectations, limits and recovery.
Perform and capture default-first and bounded non-default firmware phases.
Interpret topology/training/RAS evidence and issue the verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Correctly rejects agent BIOS execution. No source command exists; OS NUMA balancing, memory hotplug or PCIe driver changes are not equivalent.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Preserve the firmware method and add version-recorded read-only memory/NUMA/PCIe/graphics, power/thermal and RAS evidence.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The default-first lifecycle, null script and 5/10-minute fields are retained; all/random remains source text only.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Map each North Bridge field to exact memory channels/DIMMs, NUMA nodes, coherent links, root ports or graphics devices and expected reset/training consequences; diff persistent topology and RAS evidence one approved change at a time.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Exact AMD board, CPU generation, BIOS/AGESA, memory and PCIe population.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record BIOS/AGESA/BMC, OS/kernel, device firmware/drivers and topology/RAS tool versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Platform North Bridge/AMD memory and I/O topology documentation plus approved population rules.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Replaces random changes with topology-specific expected transitions and training/RAS protection.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No reduction; preserves defaults/persistence and adds memory/NUMA/PCIe topology and health coverage.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Field/topology map, values, reset/training, limits and recovery.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: OS topology may be normalized and does not prove the firmware field; firmware captures remain required.

project_override_considerations: A project may scope named fields, sockets, DIMMs, NUMA nodes and PCIe devices. Results must state population and exclusions and cannot generalize to other CPU/AGESA configurations.
expected_evidence: Exact platform/population identity, field/topology/default matrix, limits and recovery
Baseline memory/NUMA/PCIe/graphics topology, training/RAS, power/thermal and health
Load Default captures plus SPEC and topology comparison
Per-field non-default captures, persistence and expected training/topology deltas
Approved final state, logs and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The default-first and persistence lifecycle agrees with the criteria. Exact topology fields and expected deltas are project/platform readiness inputs, not contradictory facts.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The North Bridge configuration lifecycle is clear. Platform-specific topology and recovery must gate execution but do not permanently block the master case.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Agrees on manual firmware operation and adds memory/NUMA/PCIe topology and RAS safeguards.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains its topology and power evidence while correcting classification to MANUAL ONLY.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates BIOS acceptance from supporting telemetry and protects training/topology integrity with persistent identities.

review_improvement: Prevents a persisted value from being accepted when memory capacity, NUMA layout, coherency, PCIe devices or thermal behavior has regressed.
independent_technical_reasoning: Core acceptance is interactive firmware configuration and visual verification. Automated topology evidence cannot perform that manual work, so MANUAL ONLY is required.
no_automatic_retry: Do not automatically repeat North Bridge changes, training resets or recovery after memory, topology, RAS, power, boot or management anomalies; preserve first evidence and obtain engineer disposition.
